primary_task: Transcribe a user-supplied audio file to text via the OpenAI transcription API using the bundled transcribe_diarize.py CLI.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.evidence: 2. Verify `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set. ... `OPENAI_API_KEY` must be set for live API calls.
requirements.basis: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (... SaaS products, model hubs, ...)

requirements.name: api.openai.com
requirements.evidence: Transcribe audio using OpenAI ... Default to `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`
requirements.basis: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused

requirements.name: openai python package (uv or pip)
requirements.evidence: uv pip install openai / python3 -m pip install openai
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, ...)

requirements.name: bundled scripts/transcribe_diarize.py under $CODEX_HOME/skills/transcribe
requirements.basis: Manifest does not say whether the skill bundle is installed; need to check that the script exists at that path

requirements.name: audio file from user
requirements.basis: read: read files in the working directory; user_conversation grant

notes: No local transcription alternative is given; the document is OpenAI-only.
